newsitem.title: USA: Baby Bell stocks to keep underperforming - report.
newsitem.headline: Baby Bell stocks to keep underperforming - report.

text.p: The seven U.S. regional telephone companies known as the Baby Bells are likely to continue to perform poorly on the stock exchange, industry analysts told the weekly financial tabloid, Barron's.

They said changes to federal telecommunications regulations as well as concerns about new competition in local and long-distance markets would prevent their stocks from attracting much investor interest.
"On the business side, there's strong competition and it's getting stronger," Michael Mahoney of GT Global Telecommunications Fund was quoted as saying. "Pricing is coming down."
Baby Bells include Bell Atlantic Corp.
